rejected_rule.statement: The will created a fidei commissum rather than an English trust, and the devisees take their shares subject to this arrangement.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "In the opinion of their Lordships the leading clauses of this will are typical of a fidei commissum, and are inconsistent with the structure of an English Trust. ... In order to ascertain, if possible, who are the fiduciaries and who are the fideicommissaries, it is convenient to read the next two clauses together;"

meta.parties: Siti Kadija Et Al v. De Saram Et Al
